versions.changelog:
Initial release of jiugong-feixing skill.

- Provides 九宫飞星 (Nine Stars Feng Shui) for yearly, monthly, or daily calculations.
- Determines auspicious and inauspicious directions based on 九星飞布 principles.
- Supports command-line usage to specify year, month, or day.
- Outputs formatted result with detailed 吉凶 interpretation for each direction.
